svg.text: Lift pin bore chamfer, both ends
1. INTERPRET PER ASME Y14.5-2018. UNITS mm. UNLESS NOTED: X.X ±0.2, X.XX ±0.05.
2. BREAK ALL EDGES 0.2-0.4 UNLESS NOTED. NO BURRS.
3. VENT ALL BLIND HOLES IN VACUUM-EXPOSED PARTS PER DR-6 (spec/00).
4. PROVENANCE: EVERY DIMENSION TRACES PER THE SIDECAR PROVENANCE FILE OF THIS DRAWING (AIEF).
5. MESA PATTERN H 0.020 ±0.003: SURFACE ARCHITECTURE — MFG PROCESS DEFINITION, NOT SOLID GEOMETRY (spec/04; deferred-feature register).
6. BIPOLAR BURIED ELECTRODES: CO-FIRED; SEE spec/04 ELECTRODE ARCHITECTURE — NOT DIMENSIONED HERE.
7. EC-D14 He DISTRIBUTION GROOVE LAYOUT: NO GEOMETRIC AUTHORITY IN spec/04 — CARRIED OPEN (drawing-stage register).
8. CERAMIC EDGE BREAK 0.2–0.3 × 45° ALL EDGES; NO METAL WITHIN 10 mm OF TOP SURFACE AT ASSY.
ESC PUCK SEWCP-500 — Geometry / surface architecture
